venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 9/6 (MOD KE / Chef DJ).** Net sales $4,254 vs target $1,348. Food $177. Comps $84 (1.9%). 131 guests, $32.48 check avg. A nice punctuation to the week — relatively busy. Steady push until 6, slowed for about 90 minutes, then ended strong from 9:30 to midnight. A birthday party and a wedding party came in with 10–15 people each. Investor Cambel Brown came in and spent time with friends trying the different cocktails. Kitchen: smooth sailing. 86'd: Lassi. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: regular Gabe (a dad and traveling musician) back from weeks on the road — first stop after settling in with his family.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 9/6 (AM Maggie & Rachel; PM Carey).** Total net sales incl. events $16,299.42 vs target $10,632. AM $2,324.07 / D&C PM $13,975.35 / Garden-6A $3,971.68. Food $3,018.50. No events. Comps $405.90 (2.5%). 267 guests (Tock), ~$61 check avg. AM: got rocked — Heather on POS/espresso, a few IRDs and a bunch of cocktails, hit hard with pops until 3. PM: very busy night, down one in the bar, down one in the Garden, a server switcheroo on the floor; team pulled out a ~$17K Sunday and felt it. Garden solo with assists from Kodi and Daunte on a Fro Spro batch. Kitchen mostly slow with a couple of entree pops near close. Incident/injury reported: Yes (no detail given). Maintenance: lights under Garden Bar won't turn on. No-shows not charged. Favorite moment: team said it was actually a fun evening despite running around all night.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 9/6 (MOD Kyler).** Total EOD net sales $6,390 vs target $3,942. Beverage $6,236, food $104 (no real kitchen). Comps $177.03. 204 guests (SevenRooms), $31 check avg. After a chill first turn, ran full for ~4.5 hours with a late, lively crowd; kept things active later and looking at a 2am Sunday close. Tight, well-coordinated service. US Open crowd again a boost. Would have run well over $7K with a full kitchen. 3 large parties, 4 solos, 4 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Rosalie, Paper Wasp, Burner Phone. Door: started slow, amped up around 8 and stayed full; fire alarm outside for hours; industry friends, 3 anniversaries, a couple birthdays, a bridal shower. No no-shows. Menu count 18. Breakage: 1 tulip, 1 flute (guest broke, tipped extra $20). Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sunday 9/6 (MOD Joe / Chef Oscar).** Net sales $7,542 vs target $4,848. Food $1,480. Standing Room $0. Comps $260 (Saleh, Nathan, Bird, Michael, birthdays, anniversary, walk-out, DNL). 184 guests, $100.57 check avg. Very busy Sunday before Labor Day: opened with 70 covers, walk-ins filled the room by 7pm, bulk of reservations 6–8pm captured most of the sales. Waitlist from 7:30 and stayed active all night; team burned and turned to seat every party in a timely fashion. Lorenzo crushed his first live security shift. Busy night for the kitchen — shoutout to Oscar. Full house at close but a smooth ending. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: teamwork across the board.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Hot, afternoon showers with lightning, dry into the night
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 9/6 (AM Braden & Lex; PM Justin & Marcus).** Total net sales $16,612 vs target $7,410. Municipal Bar AM $4,142 / PM $8,333, Sun Club $506, Hot Eye $3,631. Food $5,846. No events. Comps $458. Guests 375 (129 AM + 246 PM OpenTable), ~$44 check avg. AM: great busy brunch (no AM write-up). PM: holiday-weekend Sunday paced much like Saturday — decent happy hour, lull at 6:30, walk-ins from 8:30 through close; four servers cut to two by 10; fair amount of IRD; bar full most of the night; no waitlist needed. Sun Club: Labor Day shindig rained out around 4 by the lightning storm, closed early. Hot Eye: full house by 9:30, at capacity by 11, DJ Maggie brought a ton of new faces, whole room became a dance floor, highest Sunday sales yet — 'live music feeds Hot Eye.' Kitchen: busy; 86'd romaine and garlic until tomorrow's truck. Maintenance: a piece of ceiling fell in THE — no one injured. Favorite moment: Earl got a rave review on his second live floor shift; Ezra stayed to close.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Sunday 9/6 (MOD Curtis Hayes).** Net sales $9,330 vs target $10,000. Food $0 (kitchen closed for the day — Josh off to recoup; snacks only). No events. Comps $327.21 (3.5%; a few VIPs and DNLs, nothing major). 229 guests, $40.57 check avg. Ripped a $9K Sunday with a heavy initial push from the line out the door; Malachi held court on the door, swapping people in and out and accommodating a 12-top. Late night is a drop-off point with a noticeable attitude shift in guests arriving from other destinations. Daisey and Alex S ran the floor smoothly with two; bar team (Frank in service, Alex T on 300, Alexis on 200) was a unit; Sophie soldiered on barback. Big pushes 4–7. 86'd: Brooklyn, all food, hojicha, Reserve NF, Reserve Mai Tai, Ruby Beauty (lassi mix). No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: old friends came in, pumped on the space.
